snippet.title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut is coming on 16th July 2026 to Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S!

K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut is the ultimate crossover between K-pop and Life Simulation! 

Step into the role of manager and build your dream idol group by scouting talent, managing schedules, choosing outfits, planning social media, and organizing the perfect album. 

Can you make it to debut?

Steam: https: //store.steampowered.com/app/1662160/Kpop_Idol_Stories_Road_to_Debut/
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10012877
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/k-pop-idol-stories-road-to-debut/9pflsh44sjz2
